cases.customer_question: Which PTS IOPT test cases and ICS documents are required for qualification of the combined Bluetooth design?
question_variants: Which PTS reports must be submitted?
What ICS files are needed for BAS and HFP?
How do we prepare required interoperability testing?
Which PTS test items are required for Option 2 qualification?
cases.actual_issue: The qualification project required interoperability testing and supporting ICS/PTS evidence for BAS, HFP, and SPP layers under the new Bluetooth SIG qualification process.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The product reused and combined existing Bluetooth designs, so additional interoperability testing was required. The consultant needed the correct ICS files and had to identify the exact mandatory PTS test cases needed for submission. Without the correct PTS evidence, the qualification package would be incomplete.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explained that RF and RF PHY ICS selections would later be cross-checked against the submitted PTS reports. The customer was instructed to obtain HFP and BAS ICS documents from the design supplier and provide them before PTS report review. The consultant also pre-identified the required IOPT PTS test cases so the testing party could execute all required coverage without omissions.
cases.decision_logic: Bluetooth SIG qualification under QPRDv3 requires interoperability testing based on the selected ICS features and included X2Core layers. PTS reports and ICS selections must remain consistent with the generated test plan and declared capabilities.
cases.final_recommendation: Collect supplier ICS files for all enabled profiles before testing. Generate the test plan early, identify all mandatory IOPT test cases, and ensure the PTS operator executes every required case and provides complete reports before submission.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Missing ICS information or incomplete PTS coverage can cause qualification review failures, missing evidence findings, retesting, and delayed product listing.
